title: Compare explicitly declared engineering subjects safely
statement: The Work records Module shall compare explicitly declared contained engineering subjects with the supplied basis, report observed gaps, and never silently replace the actor’s expected or assessed subjects.

what.problem: Refreshing caller expectations or conflating reported and observed basis can silently broaden an assessment.
what.desired_outcome: Compared basis is factual, scope-limited and distinct from the attributed judgment.

why.rationale: SR-041 requires honest reported/compared basis for current decisions; MOD-011 supplies safe declared-read checks for tasks and review preparation.

stakeholders: Engineers and agents supplying explicit command requests
Maintainers of MOD-011 and its Interface consumers

conditions: A task supplies compared reads, or review preparation checks explicitly assessed subjects.

contexts: IF-003 declared-read admission and review preparation, presented through IF-004.

how.approach: Inspect only admitted contained regular files with bounded observations and freshness checks; compare supplied expectations without executing content or converting observations to approval.

how_much.scope: Declared compared basis and explicit absence only; no standalone subject command, full-content inspection mode, universal file hashing or Git requirement.

acceptance_criteria: Compared observations identify the explicitly selected subjects and distinguish reported basis from mechanically checked basis.
Missing, unsafe, symlinked, unreadable or over-limit subjects produce explicit applicable gaps or safe rejection, never invented matching content.
Declared-read mismatch rejects a dependent mutation without partial state; observed changes during inspection cannot produce an asserted coherent match.
Only declared subjects are inspected; no dependency discovery or automatic authority selection broadens the scope.
Observations do not refresh supplied expectations or rewrite historical assessed subjects; external edits remain covered only at the defined observed checks.

sources.basis: Derive this draft lower-level obligation from the containing SR at the selected command or operational-record responsibility boundary. Allocation and acceptance criteria are design claims for review, not implementation, requirement approval, or satisfaction evidence.

Preserve the applicable current public and stored-record guarantees at this accountable boundary. The named source retains exact schemas, operation tables, classifications, limits, and historical adoption obligations; this allocation neither replaces those details nor accepts REM authoring JSON as operational records.

sources.locator: AR-015; MOD-011 declared reads and review preparation
sources.basis: Refines the existing SR-041 allocation to current compared-read support; retires predecessor full-content subject modes without weakening containment or attribution.
